{{Quote|I've lost so much. All I seem to have left are responsibilities. Being a Matriarch means putting your own needs second.|Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
'''Ranna Tao'Ven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The daughter of the Pilgrims' [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Sumari]], Tao'Ven assisted her mother as Sumari grew ill near the end of the Cold War. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] among Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s, Sumari passed away, leaving her daughter to become Matriarch, and Tao'Ven worked to lead her home of [[Kalikori village]] through the crisis&mdash;though she was ultimately unwilling to betray the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to the Flesh Raiders as her villagers desired.

==Biography==
===Daughter of the Matriarch===
{{Quote|This is my daughter, Ranna Tao'Ven. She and Scout Chief Moorint here will speak for me. I must attend to&hellip; other matters&hellip;|Sumari|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Ranna Tao'Ven was born the daughter of [[Sumari]]&mdash;a member of the religious group known as the [[Pilgrims]]. Tao'Ven and her mother were among those Pilgrims who settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] shortly after the planet's rediscovery<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> in [[3651 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Pilgrims established [[Kalikori village]] near the site of the new [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was constructing. Denied official settlement rights by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Pilgrims nevertheless remained on Tython without aid from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="Pilgrims">{{TORcite|type=codex|Twi'lek Pilgrims}}</ref> and Tao'Ven's mother succeeded [[Kolovish]] as the Pilgrims's [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]], or leader,<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Sumari became ill<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> around 3643 BBY,<ref name="Time" /> leading her daughter to take on more and more responsibility to aid her mother.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

[[File:Betrayal.png|thumb|left|Ranna tries to stop the villagers from killing the Padawan]]
Shortly after a [[Search for the Fount of Rajivari|crisis]] involving the insane villager [[Nalen Raloch]], a conflict ended by the actions of a [[The Barsen'thor|young Padawan]], the villagers observed a significant increase in activity by Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s&mdash;whose attacks had long plagued the village. The Flesh Raiders became far more organized and bold in their attacks, even going so far as to [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attack]] the Jedi Order's [[Gnarls Outpost]]. The attack was stopped when a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Flesh Raiders' leader, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]], and the Jedi was taken on as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. In light of the attack, the Padawan was sent to Kalikori to learn what the villagers knew of the Flesh Raiders' activities, and Sumari met the Jedi with her daughter and the village's [[Scout Chief]] [[Moorint]]. Sumari was forced to retire early in their conversation, leaving Tao'Ven to continue with Moorint. Moorint informed the pair of a Flesh Raider weapons cache recently discovered in the [[Upper Hollows]] region of the nearby [[Tythos Ridge]], and he asked the Padawan to destroy the weapons in order to deny the Flesh Raiders a tactical and technological advantage. However, Tao'Ven disagreed&mdash;she believed that the villagers would benefit from having the weapons, and asked the Padawan to retrieve them instead.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

{{GameLS}}
The Padawan sided with Tao'Ven and retrieved the weapons, but while the Jedi was away, the Flesh Raiders launched an [[Attack on Kalikori village|attack]] on the village that saw the [[Saylew's wife|wife]] of a villager named [[Saylew]] killed. Master Orgus Din arrived shortly afterwards and met with Moorint and Tao'Ven to discuss cooperation in the face of the Flesh Raider threat, but a furious Saylew interrupted the discussion only minutes before Din's apprentice returned with the weapons. Tao'Ven, Din, and Moorint were unable to calm the angry villager, and Saylew stormed off when the Padawan arrived with the weapons and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], who had been captured by the Flesh Raiders during a Jedi scouting mission. After Moorint and Din sent the Padawan on a [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|scouting mission]] to the ruins of the ancient Jedi [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kaleth]], Tao'Ven returned to tending her mother, who grew worse by the [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].

===Leading her people===
Her mother's illness made her late to the next meeting with Din and his student, where Moorint informed them that the scouts had located a [[Flesh Raider command base]] in the mountains that was protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Din's Padawan [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|took out]] the generator, allowing the Jedi Masters to [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|attack]] the command base, but Sumari passed away by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Padawan returned to the village. Now the village's Matriarch, Tao'Ven set aside her grief and met with the apprentice&mdash;only for the villager [[Eseni]] to interrupt their conversation with news of Flesh Raider [[Skirmish in the Kalikori village fields|sabotage]] in the village fields. Tao'Ven begged the Jedi to destroy the enemy [[toxin mine]]s that were poisoning the village's crops, and was relieved when the apprentice was successful in the mission.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Face of the Enemy|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Writer [[Hall Hood]], who wrote the Jedi Knight class storyline along with [[Drew Karpyshyn]], was responsible for Ranna Tao'Ven. He considered her a challenge to write, as he had to compress a number of emotions into only a few conversations with her.<ref name="Hood">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/303223002630340608|[[Hall Hood]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>

It is possible for a male Jedi Knight to romance Ranna as a dark side action. Females have the option to take the Oath of Family and become sisters with Ranna.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
